description: The FixedFloat-compatible status mapping as data: a FixedFloat order's status, its emergency block and whether a refund transaction is present map to exactly one OpenReceive swap state plus optional attention/refund reasons. This file is the ONLY hand-edited copy: npm run generate:models renders it into every engine next to the kernel tables (packages/js/node/src/generated/swap-state-table.ts, packages/ruby/openreceive/lib/openreceive/generated/tables.rb, packages/dotnet/BTCPayServer.Plugins.OpenReceive/Generated/OpenReceiveTables.cs, packages/php/openreceive/src/Generated/Tables.php, packages/python/openreceive/src/openreceive/_generated/tables.py), and each engine's production normalizer is a short interpreter of the rendering. spec/test-vectors/swap-state.json pins the results; npm run validate runs this table through a reference interpreter against those vectors, so a table edit that breaks a case fails before any engine runs. A provider behavior change is one row here plus one vector case.
how_to_read: status_rows is ordered and matched first-match-wins. A row matches when all three of its predicates hold; the last row is a catch-all that always matches, so an interpreter never falls off the end.

status: the provider's order status, upper-cased before matching. An exact value, or "*" for any status. status_contains (only with "*") narrows "*" to statuses containing the substring — the FAIL rule.
refund_tx_present: true or false to require that the body (or the persisted order) does or does not carry a refund transaction id (back.tx.id / refund.tx.id), or "any".
choice: the emergency block's choice, upper-cased. An exact value (REFUND, EXCHANGE, NONE), "absent" for a body whose emergency block carries no choice, or "any".

Each row produces state. attention_reason, when present, means the result also carries attention: true. refund_reason_from_emergency: true means the result's refund_reason is derived from the emergency block's status list through refund_reason_rows below (absent when no row there matches). Keys a row does not produce must be absent from the result, not null.

refund_reason_rows is ordered and matched first-match-wins on the emergency status list: every status is upper-cased, mapped through emergency_status_aliases (OVER and OVERPAID are spellings of MORE), and a row matches when all of its all_of statuses are present. No match means no refund_reason. A bare string status is a one-item list.

An overpay (MORE) takes the same self-serve full-refund path as LESS and EXPIRED — it is what the provider itself does with it. There is no partial refund of the surplus: the payout invoice is a fixed amount, so an emergency deposit is returned whole or not at all.
LIMIT rides along with LESS/MORE when the deposit fell outside the pair's limits. It says nothing the payer can act on beyond the amount itself, so it names no reason of its own.

An unrecognized status is NOT a provider-reported emergency: the catch-all labels it provider_status_unrecognized so operators land on the right runbook section, and no engine may guess a state for it.
states must be in spec/data/kernel-tables.json swap.states, attention reasons in swap.attention_reasons and refund reasons in swap.refund_reasons; npm run validate enforces all three.

status_rows.note: A completed order that carries a refund transaction was refunded, whatever the emergency block says. Checked before the plain DONE row.
FINISHED is only meaningful together with a refund transaction; without one it is not a known status and falls to the catch-all.
Provider completion is not wallet settlement: completed is deliberately non-terminal in kernel-tables.
Refund chosen, not yet paid out.
The provider chose to exchange anyway; funds may be in limbo and an operator must look, even when a refund transaction is also present.
No choice yet, or the provider's own NONE: the payer must supply a refund address. Covers underpaid, overpaid (full refund, see how_to_read) and late deposits alike.
FAILED and any provider spelling containing FAIL (e.g. PAYOUT_FAILED).
Catch-all. Unrecognized is not an emergency; see how_to_read.
